card.name: Trax, Broken Record
card.text: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell for the first time each turn, copy it, then exile it with three time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend. (At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last one is removed, cast it without paying its mana cost.)

Artifacts you control have exalted. (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each instance of exalted among permanents you control.)

card.name: The Old Man
card.text: Whenever The Old Man enters or attacks, put a decayed counter on another target creature. (It can't block. When it attacks, sacrifice it at end of combat.) Whenever a player sacrifices a creature, put a +1/+1 counter on The Old Man.

card.name: Ask and Ye Shall Receive
card.text: This land is every basic land type. (It has "{T}: Add {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, or {G}.") At the beginning of the end step, you lose the game.

card.text: First strike, vigilance, haste Creatures you control that entered this turn can't be blocked.

card.name: The King of Armello
card.text: When The King enters, you become the monarch. King's Declaration — At the beginning of your upkeep, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile three nonland cards. The monarch chooses one of them. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't cast a spell this way, each player loses 2 life.

card.name: The Lady of Pain's Rule
card.text: Players can't attack more than one player each combat. Whenever a player attacks you, The Lady deals X damage to them and you gain X life, where X is the number of attacking creatures.

card.name: The Riverfolk Company
card.text: Play with your hand revealed. During each opponent's turn, they may play cards from your hand and may spend mana of any type to cast them. Spells cast this way can't target you or permanents you control. Creatures you own but don't control are goaded. Whenever an opponent casts a spell or plays a land from your hand, draw a card.

card.name: Airoki, Apex of All
The Sapphire Star
card.text: Weapon Proficiency — Whenever an Equipment becomes attached to The Sapphire Star, the Equipment gains all abilities of itself for as long as it remains attached to them. Unattach all other Equipment attached to them. Boast — {1}{R}: Choose target creature defending player controls. Only that creature can block The Sapphire Star this turn. When it dies this turn, create a tapped Treasure token.

card.name: Baba, Central Park Witch
card.text: Whenever Baba attacks, tap target creature you don't control. If it's already tapped, it becomes a 1/1 blue Bird creature with flying and loses all other colors, creature types, and abilities until end of turn. Whenever another creature becomes tapped during your turn, Baba gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

card.name: The Rat King
card.text: When The Rat King enters, create a 1/1 black Rat creature token. Whenever one or more Rats you control attack, each opponent loses that much life and you gain that much life.

card.name: The Doorman

card.name: Bianca, Lap Sitter
